title.zh: 中国警方对宜信相关公司立案侦查，其旗下基金曾参与Circle、Figure等加密项目融资
title.en: 中国警方对宜信相关公司立案侦查，其旗下基金曾参与Circle、Figure等加密项目融资

current_state.zh: Beijing police have opened a criminal investigation into CreditEase-related companies, detaining founder Tang Ning (Tang) and other suspects, four months after the firm froze ~RMB 30bn of quasi-fixed-income redemptions for roughly 100,000 clients — a firm whose funds had invested in crypto projects including Circle and Figure.
